scores.tell: Wall of wood planks plus floor is real material, fine for category 3, but wall boards are fairly busy and the floor planks have lots of grain lines.
Busy room: window, plant, books, sofa and cushion, striped wallpaper, light rays and a house logo. It is a full environment with many props, so the hero is not central and the backdrop competes.
Flat gradient wall over a plain ledge, which suits category 2. The pale ground with a big cast shadow is a little large and empty, and the gradient sky is a bit soft.
Underwater scene with bubbles, shell, loose coins and sand. The props are small and scattered, and the shell and coins read as invented decoration. It is busier than the sand-ledge cards.
Curtain and wooden stage floor are large, quiet shapes. Only a small mic prop. It is close to the real cards' category 3, and the curtain folds are slightly detailed.
none. Flat radial rings on a plain field, matching the real tone-on-tone circle backdrops.
Full environment with a pool, tiles, wavy pink backdrop and water splash. The tiled pool deck and water ripples add a lot of small detail, and the hero is crowded by the setting.

Teal room corner with a glossy reflective floor, plus bears and balls inside. The floor reflections and the room corner are an invented environment. The backdrop is quiet but a little more than a ledge needs.
Full outdoor scene with grass tufts, rocks, clouds, distant bushes and a dirt road. It is cropped tight and has many small props. It is like the grade 2 wagon lesson, with the same environment load.
none. Flat tone-on-tone wave pattern on a plain field, matching the real pattern backdrops.
